title: Cookie Policy
description: The cookies the Monk Mantra website uses and how to control them.
html:
Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser. This page lists the ones this site uses.

Cookies we set

CookieSet byPurposeLasts
_gaGoogle Analytics 4Tells visits apart so we can count visitors2 years
_ga_Z5S619DME1Google Analytics 4Keeps track of a visit session2 years

Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights measure page views and loading speed without setting cookies.

Cookies we do not set

This site does not currently use advertising, retargeting or social-media tracking cookies. If that changes, we will update this page first.

Your choices

You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings, or use Google's opt-out browser add-on for Analytics. The site works normally without them.

Questions: hello@monkmantra.com. See also our Privacy Policy.
